title: Coconut Sweet Buns (Chinese-Style)
description: Soft, fluffy buns filled with a sweet coconut and naturally sweet filling, perfect for snacking or dessert.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine warm milk and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
2. Add sugar, mashed yams, flour, and eggs to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
5. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
6. Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
7. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
8. Place a tablespoon of coconut milk in the center of each disk. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
9. Brush the tops with egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
10. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
11. Let the buns cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
